text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"You are in a protective action zone downwind of an ammonia toxic gas leak from a rail tank car.","main_move":"STAY_IN_SEAL","main_move_text":"Stay inside and seal the room","where_to_go":"Stay where you are and shelter in place inside the closest building.","do_now":[{"text":"Seek shelter in an internal room and lock all exterior doors and windows.","advice_ids":["gas.indoor_room"]},{"text":"Close vents, interior doors, and seal the room with plastic sheeting and duct tape.","advice_ids":["gas.indoor_vents"]},{"text":"Turn off air conditioners and ventilation systems.","advice_ids":["gas.indoor_ac"]},{"text":"Take shallow breaths through a towel or cloth if vapors enter the room.","advice_ids":["gas.indoor_breathe"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not move downwind, approach the source, or go into low areas where gases collect.","advice_ids":["gas.low_areas"]},{"text":"Do not touch or walk through spilled chemical material.","advice_ids":["gas.no_touch"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"outdoors","text":"Find the closest building to shelter-in-place or move away upwind immediately.","advice_ids":["gas.outdoor_nearest_building","gas.outdoor_clean_air"]},{"situation":"vehicle","text":"Keep car windows and vents closed and shut off the air conditioner and heater.","advice_ids":["gas.vehicle"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"Medium confidence because multiple data gaps exist regarding walking distance and hospital status.","unknowns":["Exit on foot is long; official advice is to find the closest building to shelter in.","Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals; emergency status is not verified.","ERG distances are a screening estimate for the first 30 minutes of transport incidents."],"valid_while":["Wind from 45° (±22.5°) at 1.5 m/s"]}
